title: Adaptive Schauder Stochastic Mirror Descent in Banach Spaces
summary: In this paper, we introduce an adaptive regularization strategy for stochastic mirror descent (SMD) to solve a class of risk functional minimization problems in infinite-dimensional Banach spaces. This regularization strategy centers on using a Schauder basis to construct a nested family of finite-dimensional subspaces, with the dimension chosen adaptively according to the sample size $n$. We then restrict each SMD subproblem to the corresponding subspace and project the stochastic gradient onto its dual space.
